answer: Work waits on the pearl until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the marble of the next round. The dawn of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
